## Rules

- Соблюдать D118/D121/D120, D17/D18/D19/D73/D103/D113; никаких внешних записей.
- Сохранять чужие изменения; source facts пересверяются. PHP84 wrapper обязателен; перед PG — skill db-test-preflight и только *_test.
- Поведение/API/SPI/schema не менять молча ради зелёного tooling; precise decision+CHANGELOG+API/Golden для public delta.
- Каждый новый gate негатив-проверен на temp fixtures; coverage/MSI/quality scopes и пороги не снижать. Если packages/*/src меняется, surviving fixed mutations --all до завершения.
- Self-check + scoped checks; repair owning item. Независимое full-review фазы отдельное P09.8 по действующим требованиям плана.
- Current design session does not execute this item. Admission waits independent different-model design review; owner D122/D123/D124 stay unresolved for dependent release steps.
- D121 current, D119 superseded; D19 replacement is effective only after owner D122 accepted and formal plan.py supersede. Missing owner or hosted evidence prevents closure.

## Guidance

Read-only product. Consume existing green outputs and reproduce only suspicious evidence. Publish verdict through plan.py. Do not repair product or run a publisher. Hosted remote read is allowed; missing final CI is a concrete acceptance wait, not GREEN.
